name: OV760
tagline: Premium multi-functional wood stove with an integrated baking oven
description: The OV760 is a heavy-duty, multi-tier gourmet wood stove designed for simultaneous home heating and culinary use. Weighing an impressive 215kg for massive thermal heat storage, its vertical layout features a large primary combustion chamber at the center, topped by an independent built-in baking oven complete with a dedicated temperature gauge. A practical, open wood storage compartment at the very base completes this versatile and highly efficient all-in-one heating station.
features: Substantial 215kg high-mass chassis delivering immense radiant heat retention
Integrated upper baking oven compartment equipped with a front-mounted thermometer
Dual-window design with distinct viewing glass panels for both cooking and fire chambers
Convenient low-profile open base designed for clean and dry log storage
Sturdy straight top flue configuration optimized for superior drafting performance
